As Uttar Pradesh moves closer to the 2027 Assembly elections, a fresh seat-sharing debate has emerged between the Samajwadi Party and the Congress.
The Congress is reportedly seeking a significantly larger share of seats than it contested in previous elections, arguing that political conditions have changed since 2022. The SP, however, remains the principal Opposition force in the state, backed by a stronger organisational structure and social coalition.
